description: Defines the CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher class, which implements cookie change dispatching for CookieMonster, including subscription management and callback handling.

classes.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher
classes.description: Implements cookie change dispatching, managing subscriptions and callbacks for cookie changes within the CookieMonster context.

classes.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher::Subscription
classes.description: Represents individual cookie change subscriptions, handling dispatching notifications to registered callbacks.

methods.name: NameKey
methods.description: Generates a key for a cookie name.

methods.name: DomainKey
methods.description: Generates a key for a cookie domain or URL.

methods.name: AddCallbackForCookie
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to a specific cookie identified by URL and name.

methods.name: AddCallbackForUrl
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to cookies associated with a specific URL.

methods.name: AddCallbackForAllChanges
methods.description: Registers a callback for all cookie changes.

methods.name: DispatchChange
methods.description: Dispatches a cookie change event to relevant subscribers.
